answer: Sybil resistance should rest on cost and verifiable history, not a label. A newcomer starts in a garden: read-only access, small limits, and no voting weight until a public record of useful work grows. Peer endorsements act as an atlas, mapping who vouched for whom, so a cluster of fresh accounts praising each other stands out at once. A refundable bond raises the price of a gale of fake identities, while misbehaviour withers endorsements and forfeits the bond. Trust is earned slowly and revoked quickly.
